key_highlights: ASX 200 supported by resilient resources sector despite Wall Street volatility and post-midterm caution.
ANZ delivers $7.6b cash profit, but rising mortgage arrears signal intensifying household debt strain.
Australian housing market faces record downturn amid restrictive RBA policy and declining real household incomes.
AUD weakness provides tailwind to unhedged commodity exporters while amplifying imported inflation.

sectors.trend: Resources sector outperforming as iron ore steadies and high-grade gold discoveries boost exploration momentum.
sectors.implications: Earnings support for major miners; unhedged producers benefit from AUD depreciation.

sectors.trend: Solid headline earnings contrasted by climbing 90+ day home loan arrears and refinancing friction.
sectors.implications: Margin expansion has peaked; credit loss provisions are poised to compress future returns.

sectors.trend: Long-term domestic gas licensing progressing despite depressed global crude benchmarks.
sectors.implications: Regulatory de-risking for domestic gas plays, though oil majors face near-term price drag.

sectors.trend: Department stores and discretionary retail face restructuring and margin squeeze ahead of Black Friday.
sectors.implications: Heightened default risks and rental pressure across retail tenant bases.

sectors.trend: Structural demand for cloud and AI infrastructure driving outperformance in high-quality operators.
sectors.implications: Defensive growth characteristics remain attractive despite offshore tech market turbulence.

sectors.trend: Accelerating home price drops and anchor department store instability pressuring retail malls.
sectors.implications: Cap rate expansion risks and tenant replacement capex pose headwinds to distribution growth.

key_themes: Macroeconomic divergence: Resource cash flows buffering index while domestic consumer faces debt stress.
RBA monetary policy transmission: High rates accelerating property downturn and mortgage distress.
Foreign exchange dynamics: Sharp AUD depreciation boosting local-currency mining earnings.
Global spillovers: Post-US midterm political shifts and global equity market volatility.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Escalating Mortgage Delinquencies and Housing Downturn
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight pure-play retail mortgage lenders; favor diversified financials.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Sustained AUD Depreciation and Imported Inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Increase exposure to unhedged USD earners and export-oriented miners.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global Equity Volatility and Risk-Off Contagion
risk_assessment.mitigation: Utilise index put options (^AXJO) and maintain defensive liquidity buffers.
Concentrate materials exposure in lowest-quartile cost producers.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Tier 1 resource and gold producers
opportunities.rationale: Leverage weak AUD and commodity stability to capture resilient free cash flows.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to digital infrastructure leaders
opportunities.rationale: Capitalise on structural AI compute demand with clear pipeline visibility.
Commercial de-risking via NT licence grants positions developers for east-coast shortfalls.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim exposure to rate-sensitive major banks
defensive_moves.rationale: Rising mortgage arrears and historic house price declines increase asset quality risks.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight retail REITs and discretionary retail
defensive_moves.rationale: Department store bankruptcies and consumer spending contraction threaten rental income.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Deploy tactical macro hedges on the benchmark index
defensive_moves.rationale: Protect against global spillover and domestic credit deterioration.

market_outlook.short_term: Range-bound ASX 200 trading with heightened volatility; resources support counterbalances banking and retail weakness.
market_outlook.long_term: Tepid economic growth constrained by tight monetary conditions until RBA easing cycle commences.

Major bank interim trading updates and loan arrears reporting
China property sector stimulus and commodity demand indicators
US economic policy direction and Federal Reserve interest rate guidance
